_signals.x_guidance:
Otto AI exposes 42 pay-per-call endpoints across five capability tags — Market & Token Intelligence, DeFi & Markets Data, AI Creative & Tools, Portfolio & Accounts, and Execution. All endpoints require x402 V2 payment (USDC on Base, Polygon, or Solana).

How to use:
1. GET/POST any endpoint — receive 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (base64-encoded)
2. Decode header to find accepts[] array with payment options (EIP-3009 USDC, Permit2 any ERC-20, Solana USDC)
3. Sign payment and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header
4. Receive 200 with data + signed receipt in PAYMENT-RESPONSE header
5. For read-only endpoints: use SIGN-IN-WITH-X header on subsequent requests (1hr free access)

Endpoint categories:
- Market & Token Intelligence (11): News, KOL sentiment, token analysis/details/security, trending, top-holders, Base Season, mega-report
- DeFi & Markets Data (9): DeFi TVL/yield, stablecoin peg-watch, protocol fees/revenue, funding rates, perp/HL market data, TradFi macro, US equities intel
- AI Creative & Tools (4): Image gen, video gen, AI research, tx explainer
- Portfolio & Accounts (9): Wallet balances, positions, transaction history, yield positions, idle capital
- Execution (9): Swap (Odos), bridge (LiFi), deposit, withdraw, Hyperliquid perps (trade/close/modify/margin/deposit-withdraw)
